Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
When Demdemeh converts an animal retainer into an animal ally, does it
retain its other card text?

This does not matter in most cases, since most animal retainers' card
texts say "The minion with this retainer..." so they would not apply.

But Murder of Crows' text says:
"Murder of Crows inflicts 1R damage each round of combat during normal
strike resolution."

Will the Murder of Crows still inflict 1R if it is turned into an ally?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> When Demdemeh converts an animal retainer into an animal ally, does it
> retain its other card text?

No. Just its life (both the idea of its starting life and its current
life total).
